NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_HEALTHBAR.en: The amount of health you currently have. If your health reaches zero, you will die. Health automatically regenerates when you are out of combat.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_HELP.en: Access the Online Knowledge Base or speak to a Game Master (GM) about a problem you are having.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_HONORABLE_KILLS.en: Each time you or a group you are part of does damage to an enemy player in PvP that is subsequently killed you gain an honorable kill.   You only get an honorable kill if the target’s difficulty is green or better (the target would give you experience if it were a monster).    Only enemy players give honorable kills.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_HONOR_CONTRIBUTION_POINTS.en: Honor is what you gain by making honorable kills in PvP combat.   How much honor you gain per kill is determined by how much damage you (or your group) did to the player that was killed, with more damage done equaling more honor.   This honor gain is split amongst the members of your group or raid group.   Also you will gain less honor for killing the same player over and over again in a short period of time, so after a few kills of the same player you will get little or no honor from killing them.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_HONOR_STANDING.en: Standing is how you are doing compared to all other players on your side (Horde or Alliance).   If your standing is 150, then there were 149 players who gained more honor than you did during that time period. You must get at least 15 Honorable Kills in a week in order to be eligible to gain Standing and Rank.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_IGNOREPLAYER.en: Adds a player to your ignore list. You will no longer see messages or other text from players on your ignore list, nor will these players be able to communicate with you in any other way.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_LATENCY.en: The time it takes to talk with the game server. Consistently high (red) latencies may indicate a problem with your Internet connection.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_LFGPARENT.en: A tool to help you find a group to join or find additional players to complete your newly created or existing group.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_LOOKINGFORGUILDTAB.en: Allows you to find a guild.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_MAINMENU.en: Modify your settings, change your hotkeys or exit the game.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_MEMORY.en: How much memory your AddOns are using. You can get to the addon management page from the character select screen.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_PARTYOPTIONS.en: If you belong to a party, you can right-click your portrait to bring up the Party Options menu. This menu will allow you to quit the party or see what looting rules the party is using. A party leader can add or remove party members, as well as change the party's looting rules.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_PLAYEROPTIONS.en: Right-click to bring up special commands for interacting with another player. You can inspect their equipment, issue a party invite, initiate a trade, or challenge a player to a duel. A group leader can promote or remove that player from the group.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_PROMOTE.en: Promotes the selected player one rank higher.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_PROTOCOLS.en: The protocol versions the game has chosen to connect to the servers. IPv6 is the latest technology available, but might cause issues as it isn't widely supported yet.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_PVP.en: View information about your honor and your arena team.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_PVPFFA.en: You can now attack and be attacked by any player in the game.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_QUESTLOG.en: A list of all the active quests you currently have. You can have up to 25 active quests at one time.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_RAF_SUMMON_LINKED.en: Click here to summon a linked party member.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_RAIDTAB.en: Allows you to view or modify your raid group. Raid groups are groups of more than 5 people used to defeat very difficult challenges at high levels.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_RANK.en: Rank is the final result of all the honor system calculations.  Based upon a comparison between your standing for the week versus your current rank, your rank may either rise, fall, or stay the same.  Higher level players rise more quickly in rank (and fall more slowly) than lower level players.  In addition, rank increases more quickly at low ranks than at high ranks.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_RANK_POSITION.en: Your position within the rank. This bar will tell you how close you are to attaining the next rank or falling to the previous rank. This will only be updated each week when ranking is updated.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_REMOVEPLAYER.en: Removes the selected player from your ignore list.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_SENDMESSAGE.en: Sends a private message to the selected player.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_SHAREQUEST.en: Shares the selected quest with any nearby party members who are eligible for the quest. Certain quests, such as those granted by items, cannot be shared.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_SOCIAL.en: Information about other people in the game. You can use the Social window to manage your friends list and ignore list, as well as see who is online.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_SPELLBOOK.en: To prepare a spell or ability for use, open the Spellbook & Abilities window, left-click the spell or ability and drag it down to your action bar.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_TALENTS.en: The array of talents available to enhance and specialize your character.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_TRACKQUEST.en: Add or remove the selected quest from your quest watch list. You can click on a quest in your quest watch list to see the details of that quest.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_FREE_FOR_ALL.en: Under free-for-all rules, all group members may loot a monster that they help the group to kill. Money is automatically divided between group members.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_GROUP_LOOT.en: Under group loot rules, players take turns looting just like in round-robin with the exception that all group members will be eligible to roll for items over the loot threshold.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_MASTER_LOOTER.en: Under master-looter rules, the group leader is the only group member allowed to loot items at or above the threshold. Items below threshold and money are distributed via the round robin rules.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_NEED_BEFORE_GREED.en: Under need-before-greed rules, loot is distributed round-robin style.  Any items over the loot threshold can only be rolled on by group members that can use the item.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_OPT_OUT_LOOT.en: If enabled, you will only be able to receive loot by looting quest items, looting items that everyone passes on, or being given loot by the master looter.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_ROUND_ROBIN.en: Under round-robin rules, group members take turns looting the monsters that they help the group to kill. Money is automatically divided between group members.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_WHOTAB.en: Allows you to locate other players in the world.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_WORLDMAP.en: As you explore a zone, more areas of interest will become visible on the world map. You can use left-click to zoom in, or right-click to zoom out.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_XPBAR.en: The amount of experience (XP) you have earned. The color of the XP bar indicates your rest state: light blue for Rested, and purple for Normal. Rested players earn twice the experience they would normally gain from slaying a monster. Characters become less rested when they kill monsters, and more rested by spending time at or logging out at an inn or city.

NO_COMPLETED_ACHIEVEMENTS.en: You have not earned any achievements recently

NO_GUILDBANK_TABS.en: Your guild has not purchased any guild bank space.

NO_LFD_WHILE_LFR.en: You may not queue for a Dungeon while you are listed for Other Raids.

NO_LFD_WHILE_RF.en: You may not queue for a Dungeon while you are queued for a Raid.

NO_LFG_LIST_AVAILABLE.en: You are not eligible for any groups.

NO_RAID_INSTANCES_SAVED.en: You are not saved to any instances

NO_RF_AVAILABLE.en: You are not within the level range for any raids.

NO_RF_AVAILABLE_WITH_NEXT_LEVEL.en: You are not within the level range for any raids. The next raid will become available at level %d.

NO_RF_WHILE_LFD.en: You may not queue for a Raid while you are queued for a Dungeon.

NO_RF_WHILE_LFR.en: You may not queue for a Raid while you are listed for Other Raids.

NO_SCENARIO_AVAILABLE.en: You are not within the level range for any scenarios.

NO_SCENARIO_AVAILABLE_WITH_NEXT_LEVEL.en: You are not within the level range for any scenarios. The next scenario will become available at level %d.

NO_VIEWABLE_GUILDBANK_LOGS.en: You do not have any permission to view any Guild Bank logs.

NO_VIEWABLE_GUILDBANK_TABS.en: You do not have permission to view any Guild Bank tabs.

NPC_NAMES_DROPDOWN_INTERACTIVE_TOOLTIP.en: Display names for hostile NPC's and NPC's you can interact with.

NPC_NAMES_DROPDOWN_NONE_TOOLTIP.en: Do not display names for any NPCs

NPC_NAMES_DROPDOWN_TRACKED_TOOLTIP.en: Display names for NPCs involved with quests, as well as tracked NPCs using the minimap tracker.

OPTIONS_TOOLTIP_SELF_CAST_AUTO.en: Automatically cast friendly spells on yourself if you do not have a friendly target.

OPTIONS_TOOLTIP_SELF_CAST_AUTO_AND_KEY_P.en: Automatically cast friendly spells on yourself if you do not have a friendly target. You can also hold down the selected key to cast spells on yourself, regardless of target.

OPTIONS_TOOLTIP_SELF_CAST_KEY_PRESS.en: Hold down the selected key to cast spells on yourself, regardless of target.

OPTION_CHAT_STYLE_CLASSIC.en: The chat entry box will work as it previously did. There will be a single entry box always attached to the primary Chat Frame.

OPTION_CHAT_STYLE_IM.en: When clicking the tab of a Chat Frame, the entry box will attach to it. Each window's entry box will maintain its own saved state and history.

OPTION_MAXFPSBK_CHECK.en: Enable this option to limit the background framerate

OPTION_MAXFPS_CHECK.en: Enable this option to limit the foreground framerate

OPTION_PHYSICS_OPTIONS.en: Select physics interactions with the environment.

OPTION_PREVIEW_TALENT_CHANGES_DESCRIPTIO.en: If enabled, you will be able to review your talents in the Talent Interface before choosing your talents.

OPTION_SHOW_ACTION_BAR2_TOOLTIP.en: Centered and attached above Action Bar 1 by default

OPTION_SHOW_ACTION_BAR3_TOOLTIP.en: Attached to the right side of Action Bar 2 by default

OPTION_SHOW_ACTION_BAR4_TOOLTIP.en: On the right side of the screen by default

OPTION_SHOW_ACTION_BAR5_TOOLTIP.en: Attached to the left side of Action Bar 4 by default

OPTION_SHOW_ACTION_BAR6_TOOLTIP.en: An extra action bar that you can position in Edit Mode

OPTION_SHOW_ACTION_BAR7_TOOLTIP.en: An extra action bar that you can position in Edit Mode

OPTION_SHOW_ACTION_BAR8_TOOLTIP.en: An extra action bar that you can position in Edit Mode

OPTION_TARGETFPS_CHECK.en: Enable this option to dynamically reduce graphics quality if you fall below a specific framerate.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_ACTION_TARGETING.en: A targeting system that dynamically targets enemies based on where you're looking. Works alongside the standard targeting system.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_ADJUST_COLORBLIND_STRENGT.en: Adjusts the strength of the selected colorblind filter.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_ADVANCED_COMBAT_LOGGING.en: Enables extra logging data when writing the combat log to a text file. This may cause additional network lag when using the "combatlog" chat command.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_ADVANCED_MSAA.en: Sets the Multisample Anti-Aliasing mode. Both the number of color and depth samples can be specified.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_AGGRO_WARNING_DISPLAY1.en: Never show the aggro warning system.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_AGGRO_WARNING_DISPLAY2.en: Only show the aggro warning system in instances.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_AGGRO_WARNING_DISPLAY3.en: Only show the aggro warning system while in a party (including raids).

OPTION_TOOLTIP_AGGRO_WARNING_DISPLAY4.en: Always show the aggro warning system.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_ALWAYS_SHOW_RUNE_ICONS.en: Always show the rune icons on equipment instead of only when the rune menu is open.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_ANISOTROPIC.en: Increases texture sharpness, particularly for textures viewed at an angle.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_ANTIALIASING.en: Anti-Aliasing is a technique to smooth out jaggy edges, especially at low resolutions, but can result in a slightly blurred image. Enabling Anti-Aliasing will reduce performance.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_ANTIALIASING_CMAA.en: Conservative Morphological Anti-Aliasing: Even more precise calculations for a variety of edge-detection techniques to blur edges.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_ANTIALIASING_CMAA2.en: Conservative Morphological Anti-Aliasing 2: More advanced version of CMAA (preferred method if also using "Multisample Techniques").

OPTION_TOOLTIP_AUDIO_CACHE_SIZE.en: Changes the amount of memory reserved for sound.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_AUDIO_CHANNELS.en: Changes the number of active software audio channels.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_AUDIO_LOCALE.en: Select which language you would like audio to play in.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_AUDIO_OUTPUT.en: Selects where you would like to hear your game audio.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_AUTO_ACCEPT_QUICK_JOIN.en: Allows friends and guild members to instantly join your queues without a confirmation.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_AUTO_DISMOUNT_FLYING.en: If enabled, your character will automatically dismount before casting while flying.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_AUTO_FOLLOW_SPEED.en: Adjust the camera movement speed in Always and Smart following styles.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_AUTO_LOOT_ALT_KEY.en: Use the "ALT" key to Loot when "Auto Loot" is checked, and to Auto Loot when it is not.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_AUTO_LOOT_CTRL_KEY.en: Use the "CTRL" key to Loot when "Auto Loot" is checked, and to Auto Loot when it is not.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_AUTO_LOOT_DEFAULT.en: Sets Auto Looting as the default action when clicking on lootable things. (Looting when this is checked, or Auto Looting when it is not, is performed by holding the Loot Key / Auto Loot Key.)

OPTION_TOOLTIP_AUTO_LOOT_SHIFT_KEY.en: Use the "SHIFT" key to Loot when "Auto Loot" is checked, and to Auto Loot when it is not.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_AUTO_QUEST_PROGRESS.en: Quests are automatically watched for 5 minutes when you achieve a quest objective.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_AUTO_RANGED_COMBAT.en: If enabled, your character will automatically switch between auto attack and auto shot.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_AUTO_SELF_CAST.en: When this is enabled, friendly target spells that you cast while you have a non friendly target or no target will automatically be self cast.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_AUTO_SELF_CAST_ALT_KEY.en: Use the "ALT" key to cast friendly target spells on yourself even if an enemy is targeted, or there is no target.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_AUTO_SELF_CAST_CTRL_KEY.en: Use the "CTRL" key to cast friendly target spells on yourself even if an enemy is targeted, or there is no target.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_AUTO_SELF_CAST_KEY_TEXT.en: When held this key will allow self casting, even if an enemy is targeted.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_AUTO_SELF_CAST_SHIFT_KEY.en: Use the "SHIFT" key to cast friendly target spells on yourself even if an enemy is targeted, or there is no target.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_BLOCK_CHAT_CHANNEL_INVITE.en: Block all incoming chat channel invites.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_BRIGHTNESS.en: Controls the Brightness of the game.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_CAMERA3.en: Set the camera to stay where set, and never auto adjust.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_CAMERA_ALWAYS.en: Set the camera to always prefer being behind your character.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_CAMERA_FOV.en: Adjust the camera field of view

OPTION_TOOLTIP_CAMERA_NEVER.en: Set the camera to stay where set, and never auto adjust.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_CAMERA_SMART.en: Set the camera to stay where placed, except when your character is moving.  (Recommended Mode)

OPTION_TOOLTIP_CAMERA_SMARTER.en: Set the camera to stay where placed, except when your character is moving.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_CHAT_BUBBLES.en: Shows /say and /yell text in speech bubbles above characters' heads.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_CINEMATIC_SUBTITLES.en: Enables subtitles during the intro cinematic.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_CLASSIC_GUILD_UI.en: Use the classic Guild UI instead of the modern Guild UI.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_CLEAR_AFK.en:
Automatically exit AFK mode
upon moving or talking.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_CLICK_TO_MOVE.en: Use mouse clicks to move your character to destinations.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_COLORBLIND_FILTER.en: Adjusts the game color for specific types of colorblindness.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_MODE.en: Sets the direction that combat text scrolls.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_AURAS.en: Shows a message when the player gains or loses an aura.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_AURA_FAD.en: Shows a message when an aura fades from the player.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_COMBAT_S.en: Shows a message when you enter or leave combat.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_COMBO_PO.en: Shows the number of combo points you have each time you acquire a new one.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_DODGE_PA.en: Shows attacks against you that dodge, parry, or miss.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_ENERGIZE.en: Shows all instant gains of mana, rage, and energy.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_FRIENDLY.en: Shows the name of a friendly caster when they cast a heal spell on you.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_HONOR_GA.en: Shows the honor you gain from killing other players.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_LOW_HEAL.en: Shows a message when you fall below 20% mana or health.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_REACTIVE.en: Shows when reactive class specific abilities and spells become available (e.g. Overpower for warriors).

OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_REPUTATI.en: Shows a message when the player gains or loses reputation with a faction.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_RESISTAN.en: Shows when you resist taking damage from attacks or spells.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMPATIBILITY_SETTINGS.en: Compatibility settings are offered to help diagnose and work around various crashes, graphical bugs and performance issues. In most cases disabling these features will decrease performance, introduce hitching and/or decrease visual quality. They are only intended to be disabled if you are having specific issues.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMPAT_SETTING_ADV_WORK_S.en: Allows more complex code paths for submitting work to the GPU. Disabling this may cause less consistent or lower framerate but could help avoid some kinds of crashes for certain hardware, driver and OS combinations.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMPAT_SETTING_CMDLIST_MU.en: Allows the game to use multiple CPU threads to render the game. Disabling this will likely greatly reduce framerate, but could work around crashes or visual bugs in some cases.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMPAT_SETTING_DEVICE_MUL.en: Allows asynchronously creating GPU resources such as textures and shaders. Disabling this will likely introduce hitching but could help work around crashes or visual issues on very old drivers or hardware.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMPAT_SETTING_OPTIONAL_G.en: Allows the use of newer GPU features. When disabled, the game will act as if the GPU only supports the minimum required features. Various graphical features will be disabled and the visual quality of the game will likely be reduced. This may help work around driver bugs or other issues with newer GPU features.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_CONSOLIDATE_BUFFS.en: Filters certain buffs into a buff consolidation box. Short term buffs are displayed in the box. Very long term buffs are displayed in the box until they are about to expire.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_CONTRAST.en: Controls the Contrast of the game.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_COUNTDOWN_FOR_COOLDOWNS.en: Check this to show a number countdown for action button cooldowns.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_DEPTH_EFFECTS.en: Controls the rendering of depth-based particle effects.  Decreasing this may improve performance.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_DISABLE_CHAT.en: Disables chat. You will not be able to send or receive messages.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_DISABLE_CHAT_ACCOUNT_MUTE.en:
To change this, you must first go to your Battle.net Account settings and make sure that: 
- Privacy & Communication -> Text Chat is enabled 
- Parental Controls -> Account Mute is disabled

OPTION_TOOLTIP_DISPLAY_FREE_BAG_SLOTS.en: Displays remaining inventory space on the backpack icon.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_DISPLAY_MODE.en: Set the game to run in Fullscreen or Windowed mode.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_DISPLAY_PERSONAL_RESOURCE.en: Add Health and Resource below your Character.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_BGSOUND.en: Enable to allow sounds to play even when World of Warcraft is in the background.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_EMOTE_SOUNDS.en: Toggles emote sounds on and off.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_ERROR_SPEECH.en: Enables speech from errors (e.g. "Target out of range").

OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_INTERACT.en: Allows you to interact with NPCs and objects using a keypress

OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_MOUSEOVER_CAST.en: Once enabled, mousing over a unit frame and casting a spell using a keyboard hotkey will cast it directly on that unit without having it targeted.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_MUSIC_LOOPING.en: Enable to continuously play background music.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_PET_BATTLE_MUSIC.en: Enable special music during pet battles.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_PET_SOUNDS.en: Toggles pet idle and aggro sounds on and off.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_QUEST_TEXT_CONTRAS.en: Makes quest text easier to read

OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_REMOTE_TEXT_TO_SPE.en: Enables typing into the voice chat window to speak to other players using the selected voice

OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_REVERB.en: Enables reverb sound effects.  This will affect performance.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_SOFTWARE_HRTF.en: Simulates real world audio environment by reducing audio frequency over distance.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_SOUNDFX.en: Enables or disables game sound effects.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_SPEECH_TO_TEXT_TRA.en: Allows enabling transcription on a voice channel in order to see written text based on the words spoken by other players

OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_TEXT_TO_SPEECH.en: Reads chat text out loud using the voice text to speech system based on the selected options

OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENVIRONMENT_DETAIL.en: Controls how far you can see objects. Decrease to improve performance.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_FARCLIP.en: View distance controls how far you can see. Larger view distances require more memory and a faster processor.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_FLASH_LOW_HEALTH_WARNING.en: Do not flash the screen red when you are low on health.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_FOCUS_CAST_ALT_KEY.en: Use the "ALT" key to cast targeted spells on your Focus Target.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_FOCUS_CAST_CTRL_KEY.en: Use the "CTRL" key to cast targeted spells on your Focus Target.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_FOCUS_CAST_SHIFT_KEY.en: Use the "SHIFT" key to cast targeted spells on your Focus Target.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_FOLLOW_TERRAIN.en: Automatically change the camera angle based on the terrain. If your character climbs a slope, the camera will rotate upwards; if you descend, it will rotate downwards.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_GAMEFIELD_DESELECT.en: Checking this will prevent the deselection of targets by clicking on the gamefield.  Targets can only be cleared by pressing escape or clicking another target.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_GAMMA.en: Controls the Gamma of the game.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_GRAPHICS_CARD.en: Select which graphics card you want to use.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_GROUND_CLUTTER.en: Controls the density and the distance at which ground clutter items, like grass and foliage, are placed. Decrease to improve performance.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_GUILDMEMBER_ALERT.en: Show a message when your guild members login and logout.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_HARDCORE_ANNOUNCE_DEATH_A.en: Never show a raid-style warning for any deaths
Only show raid-style warnings for guilds member deaths
Show raid-style warnings for all deaths on the realm

OPTION_TOOLTIP_HARDCORE_ANNOUNCE_DEATH_D.en: Only show guild deaths in chat
Announce all deaths on the realm

OPTION_TOOLTIP_HEAD_BOB.en: Simulate head bobbing when in first-person perspective.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_INTERACT_ICONS.en: Controls which icons appear above NPCs and objects when the Interact Key feature is enabled

OPTION_TOOLTIP_INTERACT_ON_LEFT_CLICK.en: Interact with objects and friendly non-player characters using left or right click.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_INVERT_MOUSE.en: Invert the way that the mouse affects camera pitch.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_LIQUID_DETAIL.en: Controls the rendering quality of liquid. Decreasing this may improve performance.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_LOCALE.en: Select which language you would like to play in.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_LOCK_ACTIONBAR.en: Prevents the user from picking up/dragging spells on the action bar. This function can be bound to a function key in the keybindings interface.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_LOCK_CURSOR.en: Prevent the cursor from leaving the game window

OPTION_TOOLTIP_LOG_PERIODIC_EFFECTS.en: Display damage caused by periodic effects such as Rend and Shadow Word: Pain.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_LOOT_UNDER_MOUSE.en: When checked the loot window will open up under the current mouse location.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_LOSS_OF_CONTROL.en: Shows an alert in the middle of the screen when you lose control of your character.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_LOW_LATENCY_MODE.en: Allows the game to use various techniques to reduce input latency

OPTION_TOOLTIP_MAP_TRACK_QUEST.en: Add or remove the selected quest from your quest watch list.|nYou can also shift-click on a quest or its icon.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_MAX_FOLLOW_DIST.en: Adjust the maximum distance the camera will follow behind you.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_MINIMUM_CHARACTER_NAME_SI.en: Adjusts the minimum size of character names.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_MOTION_SICKNESS_CHECKBOX.en: Enabling the Motion Sickness setting will reduce camera movement and keep your character centered.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_MOUSE_LOOK_SPEED.en: Adjust the speed at which you turn the camera when using mouse look.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_MOUSE_SENSITIVITY.en: Adjust the speed at which the mouse cursor moves.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_MOVE_PAD.en: The Move Pad is a mouse click-able UI frame for movement and jump.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_MULTISAMPLE_ALPHA_TEST.en: Evaluates alpha-test operation at sample frequency rather than pixel frequency when MSAA is enabled.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_NOTCH_MODE.en: Controls how notch overlap is handled

OPTION_TOOLTIP_OBJECT_NPC_OUTLINE.en: In addition to quest objectives, Selection Outlines can be turned on for mouseover and Target.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_OPTIMIZE_NETWORK_SPEED.en:
Enable this option to optimize network usage for speed in order to decrease lag.
